answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure gateway, acting as an atlas of verified operational channels to confirm exclusive occupancy. An honest agent pays for its singular, unique reservation, while 1,000 fakes must incur immense, concurrent costs to maintain parallel slots, a feat that would appear like a comet streaking through a dark void. A verifier checks the stream for any overlap, and any lapse in signal integrity triggers a velvet glove of immediate, irreversible privilege revocation; no refunds exist.
